notes.title: Where Poppies Grow is on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/260037966/where-poppies-grow][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12063949/9d02beccba20858e57dbf4d5be575d23da8169c5.png[/img][/url]

[b]Where Poppies Grow[/b] is a serious World War I adventure game published by DEVGRU-P. Step into the shoes of a young soldier stationed in the trenches, who is unwittingly thrust into a leadership position despite his inexperience. After a pivotal and devastating loss, he wakes up on the battlefield to fine that his comrades are nowhere to be seen. Desperate to reunite with his friends and return home, he travels through enemy territory in hopes to find the new front line. This is a story about growth, adventure, and one man’s journey through war.

Back at the Sergeant or Lieutenant tier and [b]see yourself in the game[/b] as a grunt soldier, sent to die for Volk und Vaterland.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/260037966/where-poppies-grow][h1][b]Check the game out now![/b][/h1][/url]

notes.title: Support Our Next Project!
notes.notes:
[img]https://s31.postimg.org/5v9b9ug3v/Stay_Stay_Girls.png[/img]

[h1]Stay! Stay! Democratic People's Republic of Korea!: My First (and only) Trip to North Korea[/h1]

[b][i]Stay! Stay! Democratic People's Republic of Korea[/i][/b] is made by 'DEVGRU-P' a small team of American developers in the style of a [strike]classic work of literature[/strike] Japanese Visual Novel. You know exactly what we're doing here... Don't lie. With two different romance plot-lines and a multiple of endings based on your choices, [b][i]Stay! Stay! Democratic People's Republic of Korea[/i][/b] will keep you entertained for a number of playthroughs!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1930242464/go-go-democratic-peoples-republic-of-korea][img]https://s32.postimg.org/s3varrrl1/Back_Us_On_Kickstarter.png[/img][/url]


[img]https://s31.postimg.org/mttv6cnpn/Banner_Story.png[/img]


[b]STORY [/b]
The year is 2021, America is back in Afghanistan, and you, soldier, are about to get a well deserved vacation. What better way to spend it than with some of your Korean Army pen-pals, Jeong and Eunji? "Pyongyang" is just a suburb of Seoul, right?

Unfortunately not.

Welcome to [strike]North Korea[/strike] the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

Enjoy your stay... stay!

[img]https://s31.postimg.org/4ki1enp6j/Banner_Features.png[/img]

[b]FEATURES [/b]

Try and navigate your way through one of the world's most tightly controlled dictatorships, with two cute soldiers by your side. Avoid getting shot, executed, black-bagged, or tried for treason as you explore Pyongyang's most famous tourist attractions.

Stay! Stay! Democratic People's Republic of Korea will bring all the heart-warming, non-offensive humor you expect from a DEVGRU-P game! In Stay! Stay! DPRK, you will be able to...

[list]
[*]Go on vacation.
[*]See [strike]North Korea[/strike] Best Korea.
[*]Travel around with cute [strike]tour guides[/strike] military police officers.
[*]Date Them.
[*]Also there's probably a hot spring or something.
[*]We know what you're here for.
[/list]

[img]https://s31.postimg.org/g338f6dzv/Screenshots.png[/img]

[img]https://s32.postimg.org/3jmboi05x/Banner_Characters.png[/img]

[img]https://s32.postimg.org/db9eoo7yt/Jeong.png[/img]

[b]Jeong[/b] - The older sister and an Intelligence Officer in the Korean People's Army. She learned English at the Korean Ministry of State Security and speaks it very well, although she still has trouble with American slang and euphemisms.


[img]https://s32.postimg.org/xw91yyhk5/Eunji.png[/img]

[b]Eunji[/b] - The younger sister and a Military Police Officer in Pyongyang. She never learned much English and gets frustrated by Jeong speaking better than her. She has a "no-nonsense" attitude, and can out-shoot anyone else in the Pyongyang Military Police Battalion.

[img]https://s32.postimg.org/pczrvctjp/Menus.png[/img]

(Note - Stay! Stay! DPRK is not associated with OVERDRIVE © or MangaGamer ©)

notes.title: Panzermadels Now Supports Mac Systems
notes.notes:
[b]Panzermadels is now available on Mac systems.[/b]

[b]How to Run Mac Version[/b]
[list][*]Right click 'Panzermadels' in Steam.
[*]Select 'Properties' from the pop-up menu.
[*]Click on 'Betas'.
[*]Select "Macintosh" from the drop down menu.
[*]Update the game and play.
[/list]

[b]Bugs Fixes[/b]
[list][*]The game erroneously said Tiger when IS-2 was speaking in the Kitchen.
[*]Going with Panzer IV/Sherman which lead to a small bug.
[*]Some buttons that made an infinite logic loop (our programmer has been summarily shot in the courtyard for this).
[/list]

Also we are hiring a new programmer, low pay, no benefits, chance of execution, applications should be sent to [strike]Redacted[/strike].

notes.title: Panzermadels Updated to v1.0.5
notes.notes:
We're making Panzermadels Great Again #DEVGRU-P_2016.

[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Tiger's scene was looping on itself and causing shenanigans.
[*] Tog II Scene loop.
[*] Sherman/Panzer IV Scene got stuck on "a cloud of dust" line.
[*] Clicking to take one girl to the festival would result in the same girl as the last playthrough.
[/list]

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] CG Gallery after you've beaten the game.
[/list]
